radar.use: Inspect a dated radar backscatter layer beside the separately dated optical layer.
radar.quality: Check native CRS, grid, scale, nodata and polygon coverage against STAC. No separately published layover/shadow raster.
radar.rights: CC BY 4.0; contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data processed by Catalyst for Microsoft Planetary Computer.

hazards.use: Inspect flood reports missing from the installed earthquake-only GDACS adapter.
hazards.quality: Preserve provider time and geometry, group only exact referenced GDACS IDs, and label query absence as absence of reports.

weather.use: Inspect representative temperature and horizontal wind on historical pressure levels around Riyadh.
weather.quality: Native 0.25-degree samples compared directly against the retained source chunks, with below-ground samples masked.
weather.rights: Copernicus Climate Change Service ERA5. Contains modified Copernicus Climate Change Service information (2022).
